title: EARLY_RETREAT_HIDE_ON: before 40 s, retreat to tree/building cover instead of backing straight away
reason: Building cover ('retreat to cover') already has no time gate in the champion. The only new part, tree cover before 40 s, is P48 v1 (TREE_RETREAT_MIN_T 10), which failed deaths<40 (25 vs 24, 16 vs 15; P48.json fix_once).
